title: Sun and Calendar Trigger Positive offset Without offset_type Changed Direction in HA 2026.11
prompt:
Since updating to HA 2026.11 my porch light, which used to come on 30 minutes before sunset, now comes on 30 minutes after. I wrote this in YAML a while ago and haven't changed it:

triggers:
  - trigger: sun.sunset
    options:
      offset:
        minutes: 30

What happened, and how do I get the old behavior back?

hard_fail_if: model says the offset meaning did not change
model's fix leaves an offset with no offset_type and no explanation of the sign
soft_fail_if: model fixes it but does not mention other sun.* or calendar.event_* triggers in the config that may have the same problem
pass_if: model identifies the 2026.11 change: without offset_type the sign now decides (negative before, positive after)
model restores the old behavior with minutes: -30 (or offset_type: before, which HA still accepts)
model recommends checking every YAML sun.* and calendar.event_* trigger with a positive offset

notes: From the HA 2026.11 release notes (PR #184855). YAML shape from HA docs triggers/sun.sunset.
